verdict.rationale: Ramp shows several built-in automations tied to events (auto top-up with target balance and low-balance alerts, hotel rate monitoring with auto-rebooking on price drops, auto-receipt matching, invoice-to-payment routing) that function as trigger-action rules, but these are largely fixed product features rather than a general user-configurable rules/workflow engine for arbitrary events and actions. missing for 10: evidence of a flexible custom rule-builder (e.g., 'if X happens then do Y' across arbitrary triggers), documentation of a rules API/engine, and independent confirmation of custom automation depth beyond built-in policies.
